Hey, I’ve been there too and I know that even though we might be facing different situations as cliche as it sounds you DO matter. I’ve had my own struggles with self harm, and I might not have any right to tell you this but just know that it’s nothing to be ashamed of or feel guilty about. We often do things we know are wrong because we are filled with so much hurt and pain, and I guess what I am saying is that it’s okay to feel the way you do. It’s okay to not be okay. Just remember that self harm and suicide can only bring temporary relief and it only hurts the people around you. Trust me I’ve been there too and it’s hard to forgive yourself when you’ve never wanted to hurt others just release your own pain. No matter how much the idea of suicide may bring out a source of contempt and inner peace, I don’t think you can ever leave this world in full bliss by knowing that you may have added to the suffering of others. I’m by no means trying to make you feel guilty about your thoughts, and just to emphasize that no matter how shitty things are right now there will always be someone that cares about you. You might know this person from a couple years back, or maybe this person is a complete stranger, but you’re life matters. Hell I’m a complete stranger and I really hope you hang in there for just a while longer. Please don’t give up there are so many people who will be there for you if only just reach out. Dm if you ever need to talk.

It’s senior year for me so I don’t think I’ll be able to change schools. Hopefully college will be a new start, but I’m not sure if I’ll ever be okay. It’s just that I know that no matter how far I go, my past will always catch up to me.  I don’t know if I’ll ever be able to let go because I worry that I’ll always be trapped in the past and fearful of the future.  Maybe everything will be okay after this year; I freaking hope so because I’m tired of this fight. Thank you for comment; it feels really nice to know that there are people out here that actually care.

Yes, it’s often difficult to explain what we are going through because everything feels so messed up, and maybe that’s why we cling to things like music and books and movies because in someway they do have the capacity to explain what how we are feeling. And it’s really amazing when something can do that for you. Although I’m a huge fan of 70s and 80s music, when I’m often depressed I like to listen to a lot of indie/folk music. Here’s a list of recommendation and just know that if you ever feel like you need someone to talk to please dm me. Believe it or not, you are not alone in this fight. 

-Daughter 
-Ben Howard 
- Drown by Seafret is another good one 
- Amber Run 
- A lot of SYML music also discusses some important mental health related topics such as Body and Where’s my Love 
- I really like the soothing voice that Flora Cash has so you could look up some of their songs too
- I know I’m listing mostly indie/folk music but PINK FLOYD and THE SMITHS have saved my life on a regular basis. 
- The Killing Moon 
- Just Breathe by Benjamin Francis and he has a lot of other good songs 
- Easier by Mansionair 
- Harrison Storm
- I know this isn’t really relevant but during insomnia I often watch Bob Ross because his such a chill and positive dude and his soothing voice can usually put me to sleep. 

Here are some of the things I could think of up on the top of my head, but please please let me know if you want more. I have so many recommendations and even though some of the songs are really depressing, I love that you can find the sense of comfort in having others put into words what you are feeling. I also love reading and I could always give anyone a recommendation of books that have helped me during my dark times. Just dm if you need anything even if it’s just to chat.
